name: telemachos
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Telemachos instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Telemachos tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Telemachos through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Telemachos Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Telemachos only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
